note: The input font controls the loca table entry used as the glyph end offset for a retained glyph.
The input glyph contour endpoint controls the number of coordinate flags expected while trimming padding.
The computed coordinate byte count is added without checking that the resulting glyph pointer remains within glyph_end before trimming the end offset.
The possibly over-trimmed glyph end offset determines the allocated size of the subset glyf table.
The subset writer copies glyph bytes using the mismatched computed length into the newly allocated output buffer, exposing uninitialized bytes when the earlier size computation was unsound.
